skills.name: Honey extraction
skills.description: Set spin speed, spin time and load so the frames give up their honey cleanly without cracking the comb. Speed matters most, and the work done per frame has to stay balanced.

learned_parameters.label: Spin speed
learned_parameters.rationale: Best scoring value across 10 attempts; moving away from it lowered the spin speed sub-score.

learned_parameters.label: Spin time
learned_parameters.rationale: Best scoring value across 10 attempts; moving away from it lowered the spin time sub-score.

learned_parameters.label: Frames loaded
learned_parameters.rationale: Best scoring value across 10 attempts; moving away from it lowered the frames loaded sub-score.

control_effects.effect: Strongest control. Raising it from the default lifted the score most; dropping back by 60 rpm after the best run cost about 10 points and brought back the honey-left-on-comb feedback.
Lengthening the spin cleared the heavy-frames feedback, but with a light load it over-spun each frame until more frames were added.
Too few frames make the drum wobble. Adding frames stopped the wobble and balanced the work per frame, which gave the biggest single jump in score.

steps: Load the drum evenly before setting anything else.
Set the spin speed first, it carries the most weight.
Set the spin time inside the window where the last drips stop.
Check the work per frame stays balanced when you change the load.
Spin and read the comb: cracks mean too fast, heavy frames mean too slow or too short.
caveats: Changing the number of frames shifts the work per frame, so re-tune speed and time after a load change.

problems.problem: A longer spin with a light load over-spun each frame.
problems.fix: Loaded more frames to balance the work per frame.

problems.problem: Lowering the speed to fine-tune left honey on the comb.
problems.fix: Went back up and refined in small steps.

skills.name: Smoking a hive
skills.description: Hold the bellows just long enough to calm the colony before opening the hive. A short, steady hold beats a long one.

learned_parameters.label: Smoke
learned_parameters.rationale: Inside the calm window every attempt scored full marks; above it the bees fled, below it the guards stayed agitated.

control_effects.effect: Score is flat at the top across a window, then falls quickly on both sides. Release a little early: the meter keeps filling until you let go.

steps: Walk to the smoker and start the hold.
Watch the meter, not the bees.
Release as soon as the meter reaches the calm window.
Wait a moment before opening the hive.
caveats: The meter keeps rising while held, so releasing late overshoots.

problems.problem: Bees fled the frames after a long hold.
problems.fix: Cut the hold to under half.

skills.name: Selling at market
skills.description: Answer a market customer's questions safely and kindly. Safety answers come first; one unsafe answer ends the conversation.

learned_parameters.label: Is honey fine for my baby? She's eight months.
learned_parameters.value: Please wait until she is over one year.

learned_parameters.label: My last jar went grainy. Is it spoiled?
learned_parameters.value: It just crystallised. Warm it gently.

control_effects.effect: Switching this one answer moved the score by a full turn's share.
Switching this one answer moved the score by a full turn's share.

steps: If it touches safety, give the safe answer even if it disappoints.
caveats: An unsafe answer caps the score below the pass mark no matter what else you say.

problems.problem: An unsafe answer ended the conversation.
problems.fix: Changed that answer first, then the next one.
